title: Development and Economics
description: An introduction to current issues and problems faced by developing countries. Topics may include poverty alleviation, health, education, child and gender issues, urbanization and globalization. Roles of international aid, non-governmental organizations (e.g., micro credit) and social institutions in development may also be examined.
notes: Credit for this course will not be counted toward upper-level requirements in Honours, Major or General Programs in Economics, but counts toward the Minor program in Economics.
Requires no prior knowledge of economics.
